findings.source_quote: “the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.”
findings.suggested_fix: Change the ending to “sufocam a palavra, e ele se torna infrutífero”, referring to the person who hears the word.
findings.translation_quote: “os cuidados deste mundo e a sedução das riquezas sufocam a palavra, e ela se torna infrutífera.”

findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Vamos nos reconciliar” with “Vamos nos unir novamente” to express coming together again, rather than reconciliation.
